title: Incivility and Rigidity: Evaluating the Risks of Fine-Tuning LLMs for Political Argumentation
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating 'deliberative quality' in LLMs, which it defines through moral and ethical discourse dimensions such as 'Respect,' 'Compassion,' and 'Reciprocity.' It introduces and uses a rhetorical evaluation rubric to benchmark these normative qualities in AI-generated political arguments.
